1.name: Forest Cabin
1.describe: A quiet home away from home located in the woods. Live in tune with nature.

2.name: Red-Leaved Tree
2.describe: A maple tree with gorgeous leaves as red as flames. It looks all the more beautiful when the wind blows through it.

3.name: Broad-Leaved Tree

6.name: Yellow Shrubbery

7.name: Small Flowers

8.name: Bright-Yellow Tree

11.name: Blue-Green Tree
11.describe: A young, green seedling. The morning dew lingers on its leaves.

100.name: Autumnal Development Trophy
100.describe: Ears of wheat flank this giant maple leaf. You can faintly smell the comforting aroma of maple syrup from it.

101.name: Spring Development Trophy
101.describe: The three hyacinths bloom together in a bunch, their petals transparent almost like they were sculpted from glass. You can smell a pure fragrance emitting from the trophy.

102.name: Summer Development Trophy
102.describe: A trophy adorned with sunflowers and jasmine, capturing the radiance of summer.

103.name: Autumnal Development Trophy II
103.describe: Ears of wheat flank this giant maple leaf. You can faintly smell the comforting aroma of maple syrup from it.

104.name: Winter Development Trophy
104.describe: A crystal-clear flower of ice sits atop the trophy, its crystalline petals reflecting the gentle snowfall. It captures both the coolness and tranquility of the winter.

10101.name: Villa in the Woods
10101.describe: A detailed forest cabin. Enjoy a wonderful life in the countryside.

10201.name: Beary Nice Couch Set
10201.describe: An extra large bear couch set. It meets all your camping needs.

10301.name: Outdoor Table and Chairs
10301.describe: The table and chairs are illuminated by star lamps, creating a wonderful atmosphere.

10302.name: Leisurely Fishing Chair
10302.describe: For the fishing enthusiasts. You could sit here and fish all day without issue!

10303.name: Camping Gate
10303.describe: The anchor serves as a doorbell if you knock on it.

10304.name: Camping Car
10304.describe: Your villa on wheels is ready to set off at a moment's notice!

10305.name: Bear Cub Hammock
10305.describe: A bear cub hammock. Let the stars be your cradle.

10306.name: Camping Tent
10306.describe: Portable, practical, and can be set up in a flash!

10401.name: Small Boat Fishing Spot
10401.describe: The cat's dinner depends on you. Catch some fish!

10402.name: Campfire
10402.describe: The spirit of camping lies in gathering around a campfire, roasting barbecue, and telling stories!

10403.name: Camping Bath
10403.describe: There's room for two if you squeeze in!

10404.name: Beary Nice Stone Ornament
10404.describe: An ornament shaped like a bear cub, made of rocks. How adorable.

10405.name: Beary Nice Bus Stop
10405.describe: A bus stop with a bear motif. Enjoy your surroundings for a bit while you wait for the bus!

10406.name: Pile of Leaves
10406.describe: The leaves make a rustling sound as the wind blows through them.

10407.name: Portable Grill Set
10407.describe: A standard outdoor barbecue set. It has all the basics.

10408.name: Beary Nice Seesaw
10408.describe: A seesaw for the little ones. Put on your bear ear hat and come play!

10409.name: Water Pump
10409.describe: A pump that's easy to operate. Super convenient and lets you get water anywhere!

10410.name: Warning Board
10410.describe: A reminder that you're in a dangerous area. Remember: Safety first!

10411.name: Wood-Chopping Set
10411.describe: An axe and a tree stump. Lets you chop wood with ease!

10412.name: Lit Fence
10412.describe: A fence with lights installed. Keeps things bright and safe even at night!

10413.name: Wooden Barricade
10413.describe: A barricade made of wood. Reliability that you can... well, rely on!

10414.name: Steel Fence
10414.describe: A protective fence made of steel. Modest and dependable!

10415.name: New Cedar
10415.describe: A needle-leaved small tree that's just started growing. It's brimming with vitality.

10416.name: Green Pine
10416.describe: A deep-green giant tree that grows straight upward. Its aroma spreads to its surroundings.

10417.name: Stuffed Bear
10417.describe: A soft stuffed bear. Hugging it brings you comfort.

10418.name: Small Wooden barrel
10418.describe: A handmade miniature container. It smells faintly of wood.

10419.name: Forest House
10419.describe: It would be a good idea to stock it full of wilderness survival gear!

10420.name: Light Pole
10420.describe: A light pole that stands upright. Provides warm light during the night.

10421.name: Deep Space Explorer
10421.describe: A high-spec telescope. It'll take you on a journey into outer space.

10801.name: Wooden Walkway (Small)
10801.describe: A simple walkway surface made with wooden planks, allowing you to enjoy a laid-back stroll.

10803.name: Wooden Walkway (Large)

20101.name: Maple Moon House
20101.describe: A comfortable house. Come in and feel the calm and wabi-sabi.

20201.name: Hot Spring Bath
20201.describe: Soak in the hot spring and relax your body and spirit. Enjoy a moment of stillness.

20301.name: Tanuki Teahouse
20301.describe: Whether you just want to sit down or drink tea or play with the tanuki, you're welcome to do anything you like.

20302.name: Loosey-Goosey Stage
20302.describe: Care to show off your skills? Be they dancing, martial arts, or your unique talent.

20304.name: Sushi Table
20304.describe: The ingredients are ready! Tonight, we're having a fancy sushi feast!

20305.name: Folding Screen
20305.describe: An elegant folding screen. Can be used as a decoration or as a partition.

20306.name: Tea Ceremony Umbrella
20306.describe: An umbrella for outdoor tea ceremonies so you can enjoy a warm drink even in the rain.

20401.name: Maple Swing
20401.describe: Back and forth and forth and back we go!

20402.name: Practice Bale
20402.describe: A downward cut? A straight cut? A diagonal cut!

20403.name: Goldfish River
20403.describe: The goldfish are having a relaxed swim. Don't disturb them.

20404.name: Black Bunny
20404.describe: Black bunnies, white bunnies, black and white bunnies stacked on top!

20405.name: White Bunny
20405.describe: Black bunnies, white bunnies, black and white bunnies huddled together!

20406.name: Wishing Tanuki
20406.describe: Do you want a present? Then make a wish!

20407.name: Up-Facing Capybara
20407.describe: Mega-sized and adorable! Once you're done bathing, get on top of it and relax!

20408.name: Down-Facing Capybara
20408.describe: Can be switched between facing up and down whenever you like. Cuddle with it in your favorite position.

20409.name: Lovely Red Maple
20409.describe: Like butterflies, the red leaves flutter, making for a romantic autumn.

20410.name: Paulownia Leaves
20410.describe: The falling paulownia leaves add a hint of autumn atmosphere and tranquility.

20411.name: Gingko Leaves
20411.describe: This pile of golden leaves brings a warm and tranquil vibe to your garden.

20413.name: Old Tree Stump
20413.describe: A long-lived tree stump, as evidenced by its growth rings. Its rough texture speaks to nature's vicissitudes.

20414.name: Pine Log
20414.describe: An unprocessed pine log. It smells faintly of pine, unsurprisingly.

20415.name: Group of Stumps
20415.describe: A small collection of tree stumps dotting the landscape. Follow it into the woods.

20801.name: Autumn Pasture (Small)
20801.describe: An autumn pasture covering the ground. You can sense a faint warmth from it.

20802.name: Autumn Pasture (Medium)

30001.name: Warm-Hue Stone Pole Lamp
30001.describe: A traditional stone courtyard lamp that casts warm light across garden paths, creating calmness and tranquility that melts into the evening.

30002.name: Warm-Hue Stone Pole Lamp (Medium)
30002.describe: A traditional stone courtyard lamp that casts warm light across garden paths, creating calmness and tranquility that melts into the evening.

30003.name: Bunnyrific Night Light
30003.describe: This adorable rabbit-themed night light is good for more than just decoration; it also emits a gentle light.

30004.name: Courtyard Paper Lantern
30004.describe: A traditional decoration that provides soft area lighting, accenting the tranquility of the night.

30005.name: Autumn-Leaf Bridge
30005.describe: A simple arched wooden bridge spanning a pond in the courtyard.

30006.name: Stone Railing
30006.describe: Garden railing made of sturdy stone. It is cool to the touch.

30007.name: Iron Fence
30007.describe: An iron fence decorated with a floral pattern, providing safety with style.

30008.name: Spruce Tree
30008.describe: Trees provide the atmosphere for the garden, always verdant even through the changing seasons.

30009.name: Ambient Tree
30009.describe: A variety of landscape trees carefully pruned into sophisticated shapes.

30010.name: Bluestar Flower
30010.describe: Lovely light-blue, star-shaped flowers, perfect for adding a splash of color to a flowerbed's edge or for accenting the garden's perimeters.

30101.name: Tranquil Garden
30101.describe: A courtyard-style building that blends seamlessly with the garden, providing a space perfect for relaxation and enjoying the flowers.

30201.name: Glass Conservatory
30201.describe: Sunlight streams through the glass roof, and the colors of the seasons quietly bloom.

30301.name: Afternoon Gazebo
30301.describe: Tea set at the ready. Let us welcome our afternoon teatime!

30302.name: Starwisher Bridge
30302.describe: Legend has it that a shooting star will appear if you stand atop the bridge and make a wish!

30303.name: Flower Garden Arch
30303.describe: An archway, trimmed from verdant greenery, topped with a classical chandelier to illuminate the garden entrance.

30304.name: Flower Garden Gate
30304.describe: A beautiful world open to all!

30305.name: Flower Garden Table Set
30305.describe: Enjoy a relaxing afternoon teatime surrounded by the fragrance of sweets.

30401.name: Flower Garden Swing
30401.describe: Bathe in the sunshine and sway along with the sunflowers in the gentle breeze.

30402.name: Wishing Fountain
30402.describe: Toss in a coin and listen to the sound of the water reverberate with the lingering echoes of your wishes.

30403.name: Lucky Manjuu Statue
30403.describe: One pat on the head to make your day!

30404.name: Bird Bath
30404.describe: Shh... Guests often come by the water basin, so be careful not to disturb them.

30405.name: Classical Bathtub
30405.describe: An old-fashioned bathtub, perfect for relaxation. Want to try the temperature?

30406.name: Butterfly Flowerbed
30406.describe: A flowerbed beloved by butterflies, perfectly snapshotting the fleeting beauty of spring.

30407.name: Sunflower Bouquet
30407.describe: Collect these golden sunflowers, and the sun's warm blessings will come home with you as well!

30408.name: Classical Stone Column
30408.describe: Classical patterns are engraved upon these patterns, telling the story of an era bygone.

30409.name: Stone Pillar Ruins (Small)
30409.describe: These almost completely-broken ruins stand as yet another silent witness.

30410.name: Stone Pillar Ruins (Medium)
30410.describe: A broken stone pillar, only half intact at this point. Only some traces of its former carvings remain.

30411.name: Stone Pillar Ruins (Fallen)
30411.describe: These ruined pillars now serve as a makeshift habitat for small animals.

30412.name: Stone Gate Ruins
30412.describe: Only the frame of this ancient stone gateway remains. It seems to lead to a lost, unexplored realm.

30413.name: Decorative Vase
30413.describe: A mega-sized vase! The most eye-catching sight in the garden!

30414.name: Old-Fashioned Garden Lamp
30414.describe: Old-fashioned streetlights illuminate the cobblestone path, providing a warm glow for a peaceful night.

30415.name: Ambient Flowers
30415.describe: Ornamental flowers planted neatly along the garden path.

30416.name: Ambient Flowerbed
30416.describe: Neat and well-maintained flowerbeds display the beautiful aesthetic garden for your viewing pleasure.

30801.name: Cobblestone (Small)
30801.describe: Garden stone paving made from natural rocks of all shapes and sizes. Strong and durable.

30802.name: Cobblestone (Medium)
30802.describe: Garden stone paving made from natural rocks of all shapes and sizes. Strong and durable.

30803.name: Cobblestone (Large)

40002.name: Bamboo Bench
40002.describe: A long bamboo bench. Keeping you cool, it's perfect for enjoying the summer night's refreshing air.

40004.name: Wooden Gate
40004.describe: A simple wooden gate. A humble barrier between the hustle and bustle outside and the tranquility within.

40005.name: Stone Well
40005.describe: Look within, and listen to the sounds of the water that has flowed since time immemorial.

40006.name: Low Stone Wall
40006.describe: A low wall crafted from natural stone. It divides neatly and cleanly, while still giving a sense of openness.

40007.name: Wooden Fence
40007.describe: A fence made from thin pieces of wood, giving off a simple and natural feel.

40101.name: Fairy-Tale Castle
40101.describe: A fairytale castle, towering above the center of the park. The final destination of every magical journey.

40201.name: Tower in the Clouds
40201.describe: Experience the exhilarating thrill of weightlessness as you leap from the clouds.

40301.name: Rainbow Arch
40301.describe: A dreamlike, colorful archway. Beyond it lies the realm of fairytales.

40302.name: Amusement Park Gate
40302.describe: Welcome to this dreamland paradise – it's time to leave all your worries outside.

40303.name: Garden Bench
40303.describe: White benches that can be seen just about everywhere. Decorated with delicate patterns, they're perfect for a break when you need one.

40304.name: Crescent Nook
40304.describe: A crescent-shaped chair. Perfect for daydreaming or stargazing.

40401.name: Merry-Go-Round
40401.describe: Colorful wooden ponies spin and gallop to the sound of rustic music. A classic amusement park memory.

40402.name: Teacup Ride
40402.describe: Go 'round and 'round in these colorful teacups. Don't worry about getting dizzy – that's part of the fun.

40403.name: Water Slide
40403.describe: Glide down, and make a splash! Nothing beats the excitement of a satisfying cannonball!

40404.name: Ferris Wheel
40404.describe: Giant coffee cups scoop up the clouds, adorning everyone's laughter.

40405.name: Duck Floatie
40405.describe: A floatie in the shape of a big white duck. A waterpark classic that brings out your inner child.

40406.name: Star Ornament
40406.describe: An ornament that looks like a star plucked straight from the heavens.

40407.name: Plushie Bubble
40407.describe: Cute plushies are snuggling soundly inside this bubble!

40408.name: Unicorn Ornament
40408.describe: Legends say that touching a unicorn's wings will make your dreams come true.

40409.name: Unicorn Balloon
40409.describe: Hurry up and hop on! Your journey to the clouds is about to begin!

40410.name: Star Streetlight
40410.describe: The streetlights cycle through stellar colors, adding a dreamy touch to the nighttime streets.

40411.name: Park Signpost
40411.describe: Castle's to the right, and the floaties are to the left. Follow the sign and nobody gets lost, y'hear?

40412.name: Photo Station
40412.describe: A great spot for a photo. Strike a pose and capture your best smile.

40413.name: Seesaw
40413.describe: Up, and down, and up, and down~

40414.name: Garden Fence
40414.describe: Pink roses adorn this white fence, welcoming your approach with a sweet fragrance.

40415.name: Balloon Fence
40415.describe: Colorful balloons are tied to the fence, awaiting the arrival of guests.

40416.name: Pink Maple Tree
40416.describe: Maple trees with pink leaves add a dreamlike atmosphere to the park.

40417.name: Star Candy Tree
40417.describe: A pink tree decorated with candy and stars. A sweet sight to behold.

40418.name: Moon Candy Tree
40418.describe: A candy tree that looks like it sprouted right out of a fairytale tome. The moon shines brightly from the treetop.

40419.name: Tulip Garden
40419.describe: A patch of pink tulips surrounded by a white decorative fence. It's almost like a delicate oil painting.

40420.name: Bunny Garden
40420.describe: A flowerbed shaped like little bunnies. Sow the seeds of cuteness!

40801.name: Colored Tile (Small)
40801.describe: Colors dot the floor like sprinkles on a cake.

40802.name: Colored Tile (Medium)
40802.describe: Colors dot the floor like sprinkles on a cake.

40803.name: Colored Tile (Large)
40803.describe: Colors dot the floor like sprinkles on a cake.

50173.name: White Iron Fence
50173.describe: A pristine metal fence. Perfect for leaning, photo shoots, and photo shoots where you lean.

50176.name: My Little Spring Rider
50176.describe: A pony on a spring base. You, too, can be a Wild West cowboy!

50179.name: Sakura Tree
50179.describe: Its canopy is like a pink cloud. When the wind blows, petals scatter for drama.

50203.name: Stone Go Table
50203.describe: An unfinished game of Go sits atop the table, awaiting your next move.

50207.name: Garden Table
50207.describe: A wooden table laden with flower pots and gardening tools. The ultimate workbench for any gardener.

50234.name: Bamboo Fence
50234.describe: This simple fence oozes rural charm.

50300.name: Boathouse
50300.describe: A boathouse fashioned from a grounded ship. It's a real eye-catcher in the middle of town.

50301.name: Simple Shooting Range
50301.describe: A makeshift shooting range where cowgirl hopefuls can practice and show off their skills.

50302.name: Toy Jail
50302.describe: Barely big enough for one person. Scare them straight early!

50304.name: Cozy Rocking Chair
50304.describe: The manifestation of a cozy life, perfect for daydreaming or napping.

50305.name: General Goods Cart
50305.describe: A cart that travels the wilderness, supporting Wild Western towns.

50306.name: Campfire Chat
50306.describe: A place where songs and stories warm the soul.

50307.name: Fruits and Veggies Stall
50307.describe: Baskets of produce and other items are piled up. Look long enough, and you might find a surprise... or a spider.

50308.name: Oak Barrel
50308.describe: Common in taverns, reeking of malt.

50309.name: Corner Streetlight
50309.describe: A gentle glow lights the weary traveler's way.

50310.name: Warm Stove
50310.describe: A coal-burning stove, and a reliable partner in the dead of winter.

50311.name: Hammer and Anvil
50311.describe: Hammer and anvil unite to create a symphony of flame and metal.

50312.name: Town Notice Board
50312.describe: Indispensable in any town's major hub, covered in wanted posters, information, and questionable ads.

50313.name: Town Gate
50313.describe: A large gate bearing the town's emblem, welcoming all travelers.

50314.name: Hanging Rat Cage
50314.describe: Use the lever to raise or lower the hanging cage. The little rat seems to enjoy the gentle ride.

50315.name: Creaky Windmill
50315.describe: Having been used long past its service life, the windmill creaks with every turn.

50316.name: Log Fence
50316.describe: A fence crafted from logs. As simple as it is, it gets the job done.

50318.name: Abandoned Railway
50318.describe: Tracks that once hauled ore are now little more than rust and memories of the good old days.

50319.name: Wooden Horse Statue
50319.describe: This wooden horse statue can be used as a shop's signboard or other decoration.

50320.name: Haystack
50320.describe: A stack of hay. You won't find any needles here.

50321.name: Tumbleweed
50321.describe: A rolling clump of weeds. The Wild West's equivalent of crickets chirping.

50322.name: Desert Cactus
50322.describe: Just about the most common plant in the desert. Lonesome, but hardy... just like a cowboy.

50325.name: Towering Fir Tree
50325.describe: A fir standing tall even through sandstorms, guiding the traveler's way.

50347.name: Desert Tile (Small)
50347.describe: Rugged tiles set atop desert ground. Turn your life into a Western.

50348.name: Desert Tile (Medium)
50348.describe: Rugged tiles set atop desert ground. Turn your life into a Western.

50349.name: Desert Tile (Large)
50349.describe: Rugged tiles set atop desert ground. Turn your life into a Western.

50350.name: Panda Bamboo Hall
50350.describe: A great hall adorned with panda motifs and bamboo grove decorations. A particularly eye-catching rest spot on the island.

50351.name: Panda Kung-Fu Stage
50351.describe: A platform designed for martial arts demonstrations, adorned with a panda pawprint and bamboo parasols. Perfect for casual sparring.

50352.name: Panda Guqin Stand
50352.describe: A guqin stand with a panda cushion. Place your instrument onto it and strum at the strings leisurely – perhaps a fluffy melody will be born?

50353.name: Kung-Fu Practice Dummy
50353.describe: A practice dummy featuring panda motifs. A great way to warm up before sparring, but also good for testing new techniques.

50354.name: Green Stone Lantern
50354.describe: The soft lighting from this old-fashioned stone lantern adds a tranquil vibe to the garden.

50355.name: Bamboo Pillars of Cultivation
50355.describe: An arena of bamboo poles of varying heights. Great for training your footwork, balance, and reaction speed.

50356.name: Fortune-Bringing Stone Lion
50356.describe: A rotund and adorable lion statue. Imposing and dignified, yet also goofy enough to be approachable.

50357.name: Panda Main Gate
50357.describe: A main gate for welcoming visitors, adorned with panda pawprints and bamboo leaf designs. Makes you feel right at home.

50358.name: Scenic Floral Pond
50358.describe: A small landscape featuring flowering branches, a hanging scroll, and a shallow pond. Its refreshing and charming atmosphere is eye-catching indeed.

50359.name: Cyan Alchemy Crucible
50359.describe: Smoke rises from this cute-looking alchemy crucible. Wonder what's cooking inside?

50360.name: Plump Panda Statues
50360.describe: Perfectly-round panda statues. Their relaxed postures are very adorable.

50361.name: Bamboo-Shade Screen
50361.describe: A folding screen depicting bamboo shadows. Can either be used as a partition or as an elegant backdrop.

50362.name: Undecided Game Board
50362.describe: An undecided Go match that sits in the garden. Perfect for a casual match with friends during downtime.

50364.name: Panda Flag
50364.describe: A banner adorned with a panda pawprint. It solemnly adorns martial arts demonstrations and event venues.

50365.name: Celadon Water Jug
50365.describe: A water jug with clear, vibrant colors. Its simple, practical shape evokes the warmth and comfort of everyday life.

50366.name: Panda Washbasin
50366.describe: A tiny panda frolicking in a washbasin. The sparkling water surface makes for a refreshing, adorable moment.

50367.name: Bamboo Sculpture
50367.describe: A decorative piece shaped like green bamboo, adding a touch of natural greenery.

50368.name: Plump Panda Lamppost
50368.describe: A lamppost shaped like a panda. When the lights turn on, it looks like a warm, fluffy dumpling.

50369.name: Panda Vigilante
50369.describe: A panda wearing a straw hat and a cape. Despite his round figure, he somehow still exudes the aura of a chivalrous wanderer.

50370.name: Stone Chess Piece
50370.describe: An ornamental stone Chinese Chess piece. It has a substantial, weighty texture yet displays an air of playfulness.

50371.name: Bamboo-scented Wine Jug
50371.describe: A jug containing fine wine. As you approach, you can catch the faint scent of bamboo.

50372.name: Evergreen Bamboo
50372.describe: Bamboo that remains lush and green all year round, bringing a quiet and natural atmosphere to your garden.

50373.name: Fresh Bamboo Shoot
50373.describe: A bamboo shoot that has just emerged from the ground. The panda's favorite food.

50374.name: Bamboo-Stump Fence
50374.describe: A fence made by tying stalks of bamboo together with string. Its refreshing colors add a natural touch to the landscape.

50375.name: Green Stone Sculpture
50375.describe: A decorative stone lightly covered in moss. Looking at it is just so satisfying!

50376.name: Stacked Stone Sculpture
50376.describe: An object made from several stones stacked asymmetrically. The patches of moss make it even more charming.

50377.name: Relaxing Panda
50377.describe: A panda lying belly-up on the ground. Don't play the flute around this snoring, relaxing bear.

50380.name: Bamboo Grove Tile (Small)
50380.describe: A small tile made from finely-ground bamboo leaves. All the lushness of a tiny bamboo grove, right below your feet.

50381.name: Bamboo Grove Tile (Medium)
50381.describe: A medium tile made from finely-ground bamboo leaves. All the lushness of a tiny bamboo grove, right below your feet.

50382.name: Bamboo Grove Tile (Large)
50382.describe: A large tile made from finely-ground bamboo leaves. All the lushness of a tiny bamboo grove, right below your feet.
